newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Premier sees stronger growth in H2.
newsitem.headline: Premier sees stronger growth in H2.

text.p: South African foods holding group Premier Group Ltd said on Thursday that its second half should see a stronger growth rate than the first.

"The impact of further measure taken to enhance trading performance, and the benefits in interest terms flowing from the group's restructured gearing position, should combine to accelerate the rate of growth for the full financial year," the firm said in a statement with its first half results.
Earlier the group posted first half earnings per share up to 15.1 cents from 12.1 cents, at the lower end of market expectations.
But the firm warned that high prevailing South African interest rates were likely to continue to depress the economy and would lead to more competitive market conditions.
